title: EPFO Grievance: Resolve Claims, KYC, Balance Issues Online
description: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) provides an online grievance portal (EPFiGMS) for members to address various issues. Common grievances inclu.

faq.q: How long does it take for an EPFO grievance to be resolved?
faq.a: Resolution times vary depending on the complexity of the issue and the volume of complaints. Generally, EPFO aims to resolve grievances within 15-30 days, but it can sometimes take longer.

faq.q: Can I file a grievance without a UAN?
faq.a: No, for PF members, a UAN is mandatory to register a grievance on the EPFiGMS portal as it's linked to your member details. If you don't have a UAN, you might need to contact your employer or the EPFO directly for assistance.

faq.q: What if my employer is not cooperating with my PF issues?
faq.a: If your grievance is related to your employer (e.g., not depositing contributions), you should select "Employer" under "Grievance Related To" on the EPFiGMS portal. EPFO will then take it up with the employer.

faq.q: What documents should I upload with my grievance?
faq.a: Upload any document that supports your claim, such as screenshots of errors, bank statements, EPF passbook copies, claim rejection letters, or previous communication with EPFO or your employer.

faq.q: Can I appeal if I am not satisfied with the resolution?
faq.a: Yes, if you are not satisfied with the resolution provided, you can reopen the grievance or escalate it within the EPFiGMS portal. You can also send a reminder if the grievance is pending for a long time.

faq.q: Is there a fee to file an EPFO grievance online?
faq.a: No, filing a grievance through the EPFiGMS portal is completely free of charge.

faq.q: Can NRIs file an EPFO grievance online?
faq.a: Yes, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) who are or were EPFO members can also use the EPFiGMS portal to file and track their grievances from anywhere in the world.
